explanation: Breadth-first search candidate words, generating every lowercase one-character substitution. Remove dictionary words when enqueuing them so each is processed at most once; BFS gives the shortest transformation count.
timeComplexity: O(26·V·L²) expected, including construction and hashing of length-L candidate strings
spaceComplexity: O(D+VL), for D dictionary entries and V visited words
